disclaimer: Fictional demo questions. Not a customer evaluation and not a measured production result.

questions.question: How tight should the gland bolts be on the process pump?
questions.reference_answer: The tight setting for the CP-440 gland bolts on the process pump is 25 nm in a cross pattern.

questions.question: What is the seal replacement sequence before final tightening?
questions.reference_answer: The seal replacement sequence before final tightening is to isolate the pump, drain the casing, pull the bearing frame, and seat the new seal on the shaft sleeve.

questions.question: Is bearing noise a symptom of a failed seal?
questions.reference_answer: Bearing noise is not a seal symptom. A failed CP-440 seal weeps at the gland.

questions.question: What tools do I bring for a gland job?
questions.reference_answer: Bring a torque wrench, a seal hook, and solvent wipes for a gland job.

questions.question: What is the zero current for the pressure transmitter?
questions.reference_answer: The zero current for the PS-9 pressure transmitter is 4ma with the vent open to atmosphere.

questions.question: What is the span current at the reference pressure?
questions.reference_answer: The span current for the PS-9 at the reference pressure of 10bar is 20ma.

questions.question: How often is the pressure transmitter calibrated?
questions.reference_answer: Calibrate the PS-9 pressure transmitter every 180 days, and again after any overpressure trip.

questions.question: Can I calibrate while the process line is pressurized?
questions.reference_answer: Never calibrate the PS-9 while the process line is pressurized. Vent the line first.

questions.question: Which energy sources does lockout on the skid cover?
questions.reference_answer: Lockout on the skid covers electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and stored spring energy sources.

questions.question: May two technicians share a single lock?
questions.reference_answer: Two technicians may not share a single lock. Each worker applies a personal lock.

questions.question: What check is required after the locks are applied?
questions.reference_answer: After the locks are applied, the required check is a try-start that does not move the machine.

questions.question: When is a group lockbox required?
questions.reference_answer: A group lockbox is required when more than one craft works on the same isolation.

questions.question: How long is the warranty from shipment and from startup?
questions.reference_answer: The warranty lasts 18 months from shipment or 12 months from startup, whichever date comes first.

questions.question: Is seal damage from a dry run covered by warranty?
questions.reference_answer: Seal damage from a dry run is not covered by warranty.

questions.question: What must a warranty claim include?
questions.reference_answer: A warranty claim must include the serial number, the hour-meter reading, and photos of the gland.

questions.question: Which seal kit HK-17 keeps the seal warranty valid?
questions.reference_answer: Only seal kit HK-17 keeps the CP-440 seal warranty valid.

questions.question: What chunk size and overlap does the demo index use?
questions.reference_answer: The demo index uses a 512-token chunk size and a 64-token overlap.

questions.question: How many chunks does the demo chat path request?
questions.reference_answer: The demo chat path requests top-8 chunks.

questions.question: Is the reranker on by default in the demo tenant?
questions.reference_answer: The reranker is off by default in the demo tenant.

questions.question: Which equipment models are stored in chunk metadata?
questions.reference_answer: Chunk metadata stores the equipment models CP-440 and PS-9.
